description.describe_ch: 永續發展已成為減緩地球環境危機的重要觀念。本課程目的在於培養學生對於永續建築之正確觀念：1.介紹世界永續建築的潮流與實際案例；2.啟發學生對於未來住居環境及生態保育之積極態度。
description.describe_eh: Sustainable development has become an important concept for decreasing global environment crisis. Building industry, a high-pollution and high energy-consuming industry should pursue this goal in this moment. The purpose of this course is to help students develop correct concepts of sustainable buildings. It will introduce current trend of sustainable building in the world and provide applicative technologies in practice. Students would be encouraged to establish correct attitudes toward protecting our living environment and matural ecology.

targets.describe_ch: 夠定義「永續建築」的意涵，瞭解國際間有關的「地球環境永續發展」議題及其重要性。
targets.describe_en: 1. Define the meaning of "sustainable building," and know international issues about "sustainable development of globe environment."

targets.describe_ch: 學習永續建築技術及設計對策，並整合應用於建築專業領域之中
targets.describe_en: Learn sustainable building technologies and design strategies, and integrate them into the architectural profession.

targets.describe_ch: 關心永續建築新議題，培養永續設計之積極態度。
targets.describe_en: Stay informed about new issues in sustainable architecture and cultivate a proactive attitude toward sustainable design.
